_comment: ONE Vercel project serves all seven hostnames.
The rewrite below is what makes the architecture work. Every path that is
not a real file is served index.html, so a detail route like
/learn/floor or /release/origin-echo resolves without a generated page per
record. Automatic publishing depends on it: when House of Assets approves a
record, its detail route must already work.
The negative lookahead keeps real assets out of the rewrite. Without it
/engine/boot.js would be served index.html and the module would fail on a
text/html MIME type — which is exactly what happened in testing before the
Identity comes from the REQUEST HOSTNAME at runtime (engine/router.js), so
no per-domain configuration is needed here and the seven cannot drift apart.
Adding a hostname is a domain attached to this project plus a DNS record —
no code change and no second deployment.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' https: data:; media-src 'self' https:; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
